description: GElectrical is an electrical-system analysis application maintained by Manu Varkey and contributors for low- and medium-voltage distribution networks. Its schematic editor generates pandapower networks for symmetric or asymmetric power flow, daily-load time series, voltage-drop and short-circuit analysis. Protection-device curves and electrical-rule checks supplement the calculations, and drawings and reports can be exported. Coverage is global at a user-defined network or facility, with loads and time steps supplied for each case. Public Python/GTK source and documented Windows and Linux distribution routes are free under GPL-3.0. A limitation is that the maintainer explicitly expects bugs and recommends cross-checking calculated results. The rule-checking functions therefore do not establish regulatory compliance or design certification. GElectrical provides a graphical preparation and analysis workflow around pandapower (model-pandapower), useful for network design and protection studies. Dependency versions and operating-system setup require attention. No installer or sample project was downloaded, and calculations were not independently verified.
